verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party Lovable MCP server through which an external AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, and deploy apps from the client it already uses, so the product directly delivers the core of this story. Evidence about turning a user's published app into an MCP server, and about Lovable consuming custom MCP servers, covers different capabilities and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented connection and authentication setup steps, a list of the exposed tools and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
